name: [💎Dawn💎] A Legacy Time : V2
desc:
🔮A Legacy Time : V2 is a Game Based on the Popular Anime "Jojo's Bizarre Adventure" by Hirohiko Araki🔮 To get a stand, use a stand arrow.

📰 For updates check the community server down below:

📰 Check updates board for more info!

Commands:

!pay [PLAYERNAME] <---- Gives money 
!giveitem [PLAYERNAME] <---- Gives item (Item needs to be hold in hand) 
!trade [PLAYERNAME] <---- Trade STAND with someone 
!itemtrade [PLAYERNAME] <---- Trade ITEMS with someone (Both players need to hold items in their hands) !check [PLAYERNAME] <---- Check Player's Stand 

🔊Sounds are sourced from a majority of open libraries and our sound designers. These can be removed upon legitimate request.🔊
